visual.port_dirty: The charging port is packed with lint and sand.
visual.port_corroded: The charging port contacts are green with corrosion.
visual.display_lifted: The screen is lifting off the frame: something is pushing from underneath.
visual.grille_sand: The speaker grille is clogged with sand.
visual.water_indicator: The liquid contact indicator in the SIM slot is red.
visual.previous_repair: The bottom screws are chewed up: someone has already opened it.
visual.nothing_visible: Nothing looks wrong from the outside.

ammeter.no_current: {amps} A — no current flowing: the cable isn't making contact.
ammeter.trickle: {amps} A — just a trickle: the phone is on but won't take a charge.
ammeter.unstable: {amps} A — the reading jumps up and down: there's a short or corrosion on the board.
ammeter.boot_no_screen: {amps} A — it draws current like a phone booting up, but the screen stays black.
ammeter.charging_slow: {amps} A — charging, but at low current: the battery is struggling.

battery.swollen: Irregular voltage: the cell is swollen. Handle with care!
battery.dead: The cell is completely drained and won't hold a voltage.

psu.ok: Normal idle current draw: the logic board is fine.
psu.charge_ic: The charging line isn't responding: faulty charging chip.
psu.connector: Short on a display line: a connector on the board is burnt.
psu.long_screw: A broken trace under a screw: someone used a screw that was too long.
psu.short: Abnormal draw on the charging line: there's a short on the board.
psu.corrosion: Unstable current draw: there's corrosion on the logic board.

cracked_screen.name: Cracked screen
cracked_screen.diagnosis: The glass and the panel were damaged by an impact: the display needs replacing.
cracked_screen.complaint1: It slipped onto the rocks. The screen is one big spiderweb.
cracked_screen.complaint2: It fell off the scooter… you can still see something, but the touch does whatever it likes.
cracked_screen.complaint3: The glass is cracked all over, I cut my fingers when I type.
cracked_screen.clue_visual: The cracks in the glass are visible to the naked eye.
cracked_screen.clue_multimeter: It usually charges normally; if the panel is dead it draws current like it's booting but stays black.
cracked_screen.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

worn_battery.name: Worn-out battery
worn_battery.diagnosis: The battery has lost capacity over its charge cycles: it gets replaced.
worn_battery.complaint1: The battery doesn't make it to lunch. 100% in the morning, dead by noon.
worn_battery.complaint2: It shuts off at 30% when I take a photo. Then I plug it in and it comes back.
worn_battery.complaint3: I have to carry a power bank everywhere, it doesn't last at all anymore.
worn_battery.clue_visual: Nothing to see from the outside.
worn_battery.clue_multimeter: It charges, but at a lower current than normal.
worn_battery.clue_battester: Health below 70% and lots of cycles.
worn_battery.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

dead_battery.name: Dead battery
dead_battery.diagnosis: The cell is completely spent and can no longer power the phone: new battery.
dead_battery.complaint1: It won't turn on anymore. I left it charging all night, nothing.
dead_battery.complaint2: It died all of a sudden last night. Black screen, no sign of life.
dead_battery.clue_visual: Nothing to see from the outside.
dead_battery.clue_multimeter: It draws very little current and the phone won't start.
dead_battery.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

swollen_battery.name: Swollen battery
swollen_battery.diagnosis: The battery has swollen and is pushing on the screen: it has to be removed very gently and replaced.
swollen_battery.complaint1: The screen is coming off by itself, is that normal?
swollen_battery.complaint2: The phone has gotten… chubby. And it won't turn on anymore.
swollen_battery.clue_visual: The screen is lifting off the frame.
swollen_battery.clue_multimeter: It draws very little current and the phone won't start.
swollen_battery.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

port_lint.name: Dirty charging port
port_lint.diagnosis: Lint and sand packed into the bottom of the port stop the cable from making contact: it just needs cleaning.
port_lint.complaint1: It won't charge anymore. The cable doesn't go all the way in.
port_lint.complaint2: It only charges if I hold the cable bent a certain way.
port_lint.complaint3: I've tried three different chargers, no luck.
port_lint.clue_visual: Look inside the port and you can see the dirt.
port_lint.clue_multimeter: Zero amps: the cable isn't making contact.
port_lint.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

port_broken.name: Broken charging connector
port_broken.diagnosis: The port's contacts are bent or snapped: the charging port flex cable gets replaced.
port_broken.complaint1: It won't charge. The cable wobbles around in the port.
port_broken.complaint2: I yanked the cable sideways and it went crack. It hasn't charged since.
port_broken.clue_visual: The port is clean: nothing to see from the outside.
port_broken.clue_multimeter: Zero amps even with a clean port.
port_broken.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

sea_water.name: Seawater damage
sea_water.diagnosis: Salt has corroded the board and connectors: it must be taken apart and cleaned with isopropyl alcohol before the corrosion spreads.
sea_water.complaint1: I went for a swim with the phone in my pocket…
sea_water.complaint2: It fell off the boat. I fished it out right away, I swear!
sea_water.complaint3: A wave soaked my backpack. Now it's acting weird.
sea_water.clue_visual: Red liquid indicator and green corrosion in the port.
sea_water.clue_multimeter: The reading is unstable, or no current flows at all.
sea_water.clue_psu: Unstable current draw: corrosion on the board.

speaker_blown.name: Blown speaker
speaker_blown.diagnosis: The speaker's diaphragm is torn: the module needs replacing.
speaker_blown.complaint1: Music crackles like a broken radio.
speaker_blown.complaint2: I can't hear the ringtone anymore. On speakerphone it's silent.
speaker_blown.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

sand_speaker.name: Sand in the speaker
sand_speaker.diagnosis: The speaker and the port are clogged with sand: open them up and clean them, no parts needed.
sand_speaker.complaint1: It's super quiet after a day at the beach.
sand_speaker.complaint2: The sound is muffled, like there's a pillow over it.
sand_speaker.complaint3: My kid buried it in the sand. Now it sounds awful and charges when it feels like it.
sand_speaker.clue_visual: Sand in the grille and in the charging port.
sand_speaker.clue_multimeter: Zero amps: there's sand in the port too.
sand_speaker.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

earpiece_muffled.name: Clogged earpiece speaker
earpiece_muffled.diagnosis: The earpiece speaker's mesh is blocked with dirt: it has to be cleaned from the inside.
earpiece_muffled.complaint1: On calls I can barely hear anything, I have to use speakerphone.
earpiece_muffled.complaint2: People sound miles away when I'm on the phone.
earpiece_muffled.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

rear_camera_broken.name: Faulty rear camera
rear_camera_broken.diagnosis: The rear camera module is damaged: it gets replaced.
rear_camera_broken.complaint1: Every photo comes out blurry and the camera makes a buzzing noise.
rear_camera_broken.complaint2: I open the camera and all I see is black.
rear_camera_broken.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

front_camera_broken.name: Faulty front camera
front_camera_broken.diagnosis: The front module is damaged: it gets replaced, bearing in mind that sensors paired to the board may lose features.
front_camera_broken.complaint1: No more selfies: the front camera stays black.
front_camera_broken.complaint2: Nobody can see me on video calls.
front_camera_broken.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

taptic_dead.name: Faulty vibration
taptic_dead.diagnosis: The vibration motor is jammed: the haptic engine gets replaced.
taptic_dead.complaint1: It doesn't vibrate anymore. I miss every call.
taptic_dead.complaint2: It whines like a mosquito instead of vibrating.
taptic_dead.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

display_lines.name: Lines on the screen
display_lines.diagnosis: The display connector is corroded by moisture: clean it with isopropyl alcohol, no need to replace the screen.
display_lines.complaint1: The screen shows green lines, but the glass isn't broken.
display_lines.complaint2: Every now and then the screen flickers and goes all stripy.
display_lines.clue_multimeter: It draws current like it's booting, but the screen shows nothing useful.
display_lines.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

loose_connector.name: Loose display connector
loose_connector.diagnosis: After a botched repair the display flex cable has popped out of its socket: it just needs reconnecting.
loose_connector.complaint1: A friend “who knows about these things” opened it up for me. Now the screen is black.
loose_connector.complaint2: It vibrates and rings, but the screen won't come on.
loose_connector.clue_visual: The screws are chewed up: it's been opened before.
loose_connector.clue_multimeter: It draws current like it's booting, but the screen stays black.
loose_connector.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

sand_everywhere.name: Sand everywhere
sand_everywhere.diagnosis: Sand has worked its way right inside the housing: full teardown and cleaning of every component.
sand_everywhere.complaint1: It was buried on the beach for an hour. It crunches!
sand_everywhere.complaint2: I can feel sand under the buttons and it doesn't charge properly anymore.
sand_everywhere.clue_visual: Sand in the charging port, sometimes in the grille too.
sand_everywhere.clue_multimeter: Zero amps: the port is full of sand.
sand_everywhere.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

back_glass_cracked.name: Cracked back glass
back_glass_cracked.diagnosis: The back glass is cracked: on this model it's removed and replaced from the rear.
back_glass_cracked.complaint1: The back is cracked all over and wireless charging has stopped working.
back_glass_cracked.complaint2: The back keeps shedding bits of glass in my pocket.
back_glass_cracked.clue_visual: The cracks on the back are visible to the naked eye.
back_glass_cracked.clue_multimeter: It charges normally with a cable.
back_glass_cracked.clue_psu: The logic board checks out fine.

charge_ic.name: Faulty charging chip
charge_ic.diagnosis: The integrated circuit that manages charging is burnt out (often thanks to cheap chargers): micro-soldering on the board.
charge_ic.complaint1: It won't charge with any cable. And I've already had the port replaced!
charge_ic.complaint2: It says “charging” but the percentage keeps dropping.
charge_ic.clue_multimeter: Only a trickle of current gets through.
charge_ic.clue_psu: The charging line isn't responding: it's the chip.

burnt_connector.name: Burnt connector on the board
burnt_connector.diagnosis: The display connector on the logic board is burnt: it has to be rebuilt with the microscope and the soldering iron.
burnt_connector.complaint1: Black screen. I've already had two new ones fitted and nothing changes!
burnt_connector.complaint2: It sparked while they were repairing it, then nothing.
burnt_connector.clue_multimeter: It draws current like it's booting, but the screen stays black.
burnt_connector.clue_psu: Short on a display line: burnt connector.
